en: Colorized historic view of a town market square with cobblestone paving, a curved balustrade and steps in the foreground, and several 3‑ to 4‑story bourgeois townhouses with shops on the ground floor. Signs on the buildings advertise a Kräutergewölbe (herbal shop), a confectionery and café, and other businesses. On the right stands a larger building with a clock tower. The sky is lightly clouded and tinted blue. The top of the card is printed with the location and the word 'Markt.'
